'''Chuonde''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Spine Ridge]] [[sept]] of the [[Miagoma]] [[Aiel]]. 

== Activities ==
She died at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].

On the evening after the Battle of Dumai's Wells, [[Perrin Aybara]] finds [[Rand al'Thor]] sitting alone. Rand is grieving and upset over the death of 151 Maidens in the battle. Perrin sits and listens as Rand begins reciting the names of all the Maidens killed; Chuonde's is the second name in the list. {{ref/book|7|2}}
